key_concepts: Cell division increases cell number during growth and wound healing
Mitosis produces genetically identical daughter cells for growth and repair
Meiosis produces gametes and occurs in reproductive organs
Mitosis consists of prophase, metaphase, anaphase, and telophase
In prophase chromosomes condense, the nucleolus fades, the nuclear membrane breaks down, a
In metaphase chromosomes align at the cell equator and attach to spindle fibers by their c
In anaphase sister chromatids separate and move toward opposite poles
In telophase chromosomes reach opposite poles and new nuclear envelopes form
Cytokinesis divides the cytoplasm, forming a cleavage furrow in animal cells and a cell pl
Mitosis maintains chromosome number in daughter cells
A duplicated chromosome consists of two sister chromatids joined at a centromere
Meiosis is necessary for sexual reproduction and organism development
